pr_title: STM32 mcu support the Vbat monitoring channel
pr_body:
Adding the support of the Vbat monitoring internal channel on ADC
It includes a sample application (similar to the samples/sensor/stm32_temp_sensor) to demonstrate the Vbat monitoring

Valid on nucleo_g071rb as a first target, to be extended to any stm32 mcu with Vbat internal channel on ADC
For example, on the stm32G071, ADC 1 channel 14 is for internal VBat measurement with an resistor divider of 1/3
On stm32F401, the Vbat monitoring is available on ADC1 channel 18 with a bridge divider of 4.

requires https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/pull/43861

**NOTE**
 this PR only configure the Vbat measurement for a nucleo_g071rb through a overlay in the sample
 A new PR must come to include the `has-vbat-channel; ` to the ADC node of any stm32  DTS


Fixes https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/issues/41772

Signed-off-by: Francois Ramu [francois.ramu@st.com](mailto:francois.ramu@st.com)

After going through #43863, I've tested my driver patch again and found that the VBAT can be read properly if `ADC_ACQ_TIME_MAX` is used as the acquisition time.

So, to read the VBAT:
1. Set the common path for the VBAT
2. Read the channel normally with `ADC_ACQ_TIME_MAX` as the acquisition time

review_comments: Sorry, I have read it to fast. You are not adding a new property, but here you adding another way to get it the ADC reference value, which was already available from the standard API.

ok, then does it mean CONFIG_STM32_VBAT is not compatible with all series ?
**stm32F1x** has no Vbat monitoring channel (but has a temperature sensor channel)

This line will set the common path for `LL_ADC_PATH_INTERNAL_VBAT`, which connects the VBAT pin to the internal voltage divider. According to the reference manual, the connection should only be made during the sampling, and VBAT should be disconnected from the voltage divider after sampling to avoid power drain.

I think something should call `LL_ADC_SetCommonPathInternalChRem()` at the end of `start_read` or in `adc_stm32_read` after `start_read` to remove `LL_ADC_PATH_INTERNAL_VBAT`

The driver should setup the channel (`adc_channel_setup`) to sample the VBAT before `adc_read`, Otherwise I guess this driver can't read its desired channel, if other ADC clients configured the channel to something else after `stm32_vbat_init`.
Instead of adding a new `vref-mv` property, you should use `adc_ref_internal(data->adc)` instead, as this value is already defined at the ADC level.
The reference manual suggests that the link to be enabled only when vbat is being sampled. Do you mind implementing that in this PR as well?
